items.followUp: What is a couple in terms of the forces that form it?

rubric.why: Identifies the forces in a couple as equal and opposite.
rubric.description: The two forces are equal and opposite.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the forces are equal and opposite.

rubric.why: States that the forces act on separated parallel lines of action.
rubric.description: The forces act along different, separated parallel lines of action.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the parallel lines of action are different or separated.

modelAnswer: A couple is formed by two equal and opposite parallel forces.
They act along different parallel lines of action, separated from each other.

items.followUp: Define plasma and state two of its properties.

rubric.why: Identifies plasma as an ionized gas.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for defining plasma as an ionized or ionised gas.

rubric.why: Requires two characteristic properties of plasma: electrical conductivity and response to fields.
rubric.description: Plasma conducts electricity and is affected by electric or magnetic fields.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating both that plasma conducts electricity and that it is affected by electric or magnetic fields.

modelAnswer: It conducts electricity and is affected by electric and magnetic fields.
